caption: The drawing features a large, cylindrical glass mug with a prominent handle on the right side, depicted in shades of gray pencil on an off-white background. The mug is decorated with etched or engraved ornamental patterns that include swirling lines, dots, and abstract motifs along its surface. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a small inset sketch of the mug viewed from a different angle, revealing a single swirled line design on its surface. In the lower right corner, another rectangular inset displays a flat decorative pattern, featuring a basket-like motif with radiating leaves or flowers, swirls, dots, and symmetrical designs, also rendered in gray pencil. The composition centers the main mug, with the two insets providing additional views and ornamentation details. The overall color is monochrome, utilizing only variations of gray.
title: Mug
